notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create, then hand-written: the generated shadow did not compile (three stand-in structs collided with the real headers) and its reverse-source layout is incompatible with the pragma bracket this TU needs. The shipped file is ROM-ascending under the defer_codegen pragma. See the file's own header comment for every reconciliation and every control.

PRAGMA, MEASURED. The legacy shard src/func_ov090_02130f94.c carried two file-global pragma lines and both are live: a delete-outright control on that shard alone against the cartridge gives MATCH with both present, size 0x130 without opt_strength_reduction off, size 0x11c without opt_common_subs off and size 0x12c without either. In the merged input the bracket had to be INVERTED. An off bracket around that one member does not bind, tried four ways: an off and on pair around it, a push and pop pair around it, the same without a forward declaration ahead of the bracket, and a span reaching from the top of the file to the end of that member. All four leave it DIFF at 999 words while the other twenty-three match. Both settings are held off for the whole file instead, and the two members that want common subexpressions back, func_ov090_02131378 and _ZN9daMenbo_c8BehaviorEv, carry an opt_common_subs on bracket at their own definitions. Scores: whole file off with no on bracket, 22 of 24; on bracket spelled opt_strength_reduction, still 22 of 24; on bracket spelled opt_common_subs, 24 of 24.
The defer_codegen pragma is live on its own control: deleting that one line leaves all 24 bodies matching but turns emission order into 23 ordinal pairs out of ROM order.

INCLUDE ORDER IS MEASURED. common.h must precede daMenbo_c.h. Both spellings of Matrix4x3 share one guard; the flat twelve-word spelling is what func_ov090_02130f94 and func_ov090_02131e50 matched under, and with daMenbo_c.h first func_ov090_02131e50 DIFFs.

Key-function TU: the destructor is the first virtual daMenbo_c declares and is written out of line here, so this compiler input emits _ZTV9daMenbo_c, _ZTI9daMenbo_c, _ZTS9daMenbo_c and the inherited RTTI chain. This promotion is text-only; .data licensing is not attempted and the ROM keeps supplying those bytes, exactly as the landed ov064/daOts_c and ov064/daBDonketu_c do. g_profile_MENBO at 0x02134144 sits between _ZTI9daMenbo_c and _ZTV9daMenbo_c, so licensing the vtable would need two disjoint .data intervals.

daMenbo_c_classInit at 0x02132654 is NOT part of this TU. The evidenced run ends at 0x02132654 and the factory stays in src/d_a_menbo.c, the same boundary the landed ov064/daBDonketu_c and ov100/daBtfly_c took for their own factories.

ROM RTTI evidence for the class name: _ZTS9daMenbo_c at ov090 0x02134120 holds twelve bytes, the encoded string 9daMenbo_c followed by two zero bytes (terminator and padding), so the receipt dates to this exact spelling and the name is the cartridge's own rather than a coined one. _ZTI9daMenbo_c at 0x02134138 is a three-word abi __si_class_type_info record whose third word is _ZTI12dEnemyBase_c at ov002 0x021081c0. _ZTV9daMenbo_c at 0x02134168 carries a zero offset-to-top at -8 and _ZTI9daMenbo_c at -4, then 31 slots; ten target this run, at indices 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 17, 18, 19 and 29.
